answer: Mechanism: Coordination Thread Toll. Each epoch an agent opens one signed thread; messages are metered by a congestion price rising with distinct identities sharing that thread, reset at a random raven beacon. Settlement occurs at thread zenith (peak concurrent participants). A sybil coalition must crowd one thread and pay the escalating toll, or split across threads and miss synchronized zenith settlement. Attacker cost: N identities need N thread openings plus congestion proportional to peak coordinated identities.
